description: A wide-angle photograph depicts a body of water, likely coastal or open sea, with a rugged mountain range in the background. The water is choppy with whitecaps, indicative of wind, and exhibits a blue-green colour. Two white sailboats are prominently visible in the mid-ground, and several larger, less distinct vessels (possibly cargo ships) are present on the distant horizon. The background mountains appear hazy and indistinct, blending into a pale, overcast sky. This scene represents open water areas, such as those defined as coastal waters by the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC), which extend up to one nautical mile seawards from the coastline.
